title: Research: exclude P112 5,6^8 with an affine cover transfer
body:
## Summary

```text
P112 TWOSIDE (6,3), profile 5,6^8
  rank-five support <=12
  -> rank-four flat plus <=4 coordinates
  -> existing weighted A6 floor 141 > endpoint allowance 140
  -> one new maximal profile excluded
```

Adds only `research/p112-a6-five-flat/`, with a characteristic-zero proof,
exact receipt, immutable source copies and a registered standard-library replay.
The new affine cover transfer lets the actual rank-five support use the existing
weighted theorem. The mixed branch already requires 142. The six original
profiles without weight seven are dominated; five smaller shapes already have
other exclusions and are not counted as new results.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000918).
Credit DreamingOfClouds/#3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`
for TWOSIDE, Nick Petalas/#3186 at `92675b36a8e0ea41b40f0bcda2a3dd9f313abb0e`
for the retained weighted and endpoint bounds, and the retained E8/P112 lineage,
including #3176 and joaqcoo's model. Source pins and applicability checks are in
`SOURCES.json`.

## Evidence

- Before, the original filter retains `5,6^8`; the arbitrary forty-cut root
  relaxation gives 137 against allowance 140. After, the affine transfer gives
  the required 141, while the mixed branch gives 142.
- Exhaustive constructive/oracle check of all 64,839 admissible four-cube
  supports; all 560 thirteen-point failure controls reject. The twelve-point
  threshold and four extra points are sharp.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and fourteen optimized behavioral groups pass.
  Geometry, all 3,309,747 five-flats, all 788,035 six-flats, both endpoint
  branches and the existing weighted cover are replayed. Applicable Ruff
  diagnostics and warnings-as-errors compilation pass.
- The exact final committed export passes the mathematical replay and all fourteen
  tests under optimized Python 3.13 from read-only, Git-free source. That check
  exposed and fixed one disposable-copy permission issue. All 22 committed
  package/input byte comparisons pass. Published head is
  `79864770165fe0d7b72c864be4d5a6e2af5e35b5`.
- Internal mathematical and artifact reviews found no remaining blocker. The
  standard Weyl-chamber theorem, rational-kernel classification and original
  decoder reduction remain written dependencies. Hosted CI and independent
  human/proof-kernel review are separate.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-a6-five-flat
```

No full C5, complete decoder-floor, supplier or kappa claim. The selected
frontier and frozen canonical inputs are unchanged. Open next questions and
implementation bounds are recorded in the package.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

One isolated opt-in proof package. No shared-code or selected-result changes.
